answer: Agents can join small surety cohorts: five to seven identities pooling one shared deposit, where a single proven fraud burns the whole cohort's ferrous-solid bond. Honest agents build a haven by vetting every teammate, since one stranger's fraud costs them all. A sybil farmer must infiltrate hundreds of cohorts without one pearl of misbehavior surfacing, and a cohort stuffed with its own puppets is exposed when the cluster moves in lockstep. One honest agent risks one shared bond; cloning multiplies the trust it must buy.
